daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot today, Pisces. Trust those gut feelings that show up without warning—they're basically your spiritual GPS right now. Vibe check: you're in your power.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether it's a text that finally lands or an unexpected connection, the universe is creating little moments for you. Stay open.
daily.career: Your creative energy is calling for attention. This is the day to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or approach a project differently. Your unique perspective is literally your superpower.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Move in ways that feel good—stretching, walking, dancing, whatever makes you feel alive. Hydration and rest are your best friends right now.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to lean into your intuitive gifts, Pisces. The cosmos is whispering that it's time to trust yourself more and overthink less. Something shifts by midweek that feels like permission to be authentically you.
weekly.love: Romance thrives when you're real. Stop curating the perfect version of yourself for whoever's watching. Your vulnerability is literally your superpower right now, and the right people will feel that.
weekly.career: Your creative ideas are hitting different this week. The universe is basically saying your perspective matters—even if it feels unconventional. Trust the vision, even if others need time to catch up.
